test_name: Verify Filtering Products by Price Range
description: Validate that the filtering functionality by price range works as expected on the Men's category page.
steps: Navigate to the Men's category page using the main navigation menu.
Scroll to the price filter section on the sidebar.
Enter a minimum price in the 'Min price' field.
Enter a maximum price in the 'Max price' field.
Verify that the product list updates to show only products within the specified price range.
expected_results: The product list updates to match the specified price range.
Only products within the range are displayed.
edge_cases: No products available for the given price range.
Incorrect results displayed due to backend issues.
data_requirements: Products with varying price ranges in the Men's category.
Backend support to filter products by price.
dependencies: The price filter functionality is implemented.
api_interactions: Fetch filtered product data based on price criteria.
performance_metrics: Response time for applying the price filter.
Time taken to update the product list.
accessibility_requirements: Ensure labels for 'Min price' and 'Max price' fields are accessible.
Verify keyboard navigation for the filter section.
